Welcome to The Cove Bar and Grill
High energy local bar and restaurant with live entertainment in Murrieta, CA
The Cove Bar and Grill was re-opened two years ago by three retired firefighters. Our goal is to provide a place where the community could gather form new friendships, listen to live music and enjoy great food and drinks. As retired firefighters we looked forward to being a part of an establishment where we could enjoy the camaraderie and friendships we were able to experience in our careers.
The Cove Bar and Grill is open and natural light filled with generous beverage offerings, guest curated music resonating throughout the day. Come and enjoy NFL football, UFC events, live local touring bands, karaoke, pool tables, great foot and weekend brunch.

Live Entertainment
The Cove offers a wide variety of entertainment options from nationally touring original, tribute, dance and cover bands to variety, drag and burlesque nights. There’s always something happening at The Cove. Check out our event calendar for all our upcoming live entertainment events.
Our Events

Upscale Food & Craft Cocktails
While we have so many regular favorites: The old school classic burger, club and caesar salads, french dip and philly cheese steak sandwiches, lasagna and more, we pride ourselves on our upscale menu items created by our executive chef. Come in and try these new creations: tenderloin steak, blackened shrimp, or salmon salads. Spicy senorita, or the godfather pastas, shrimp mango tacos and more. And while you’re here try one of our signature craft cocktails like the mayor’s old fashion, our scratch margaritas, the rio, cougar juice and so many more. Also, you won’t find a more extensive selection of popular and high-end spirit choices anywhere in the valley.

Murrieta’s BEST Happy Hour
Every Day from 3pm – 7pm
Come and join us for Murrieta’s best happy hour. Enjoy our friendly and fun atmosphere with an ice-cold draft beer, a glass of fine wine, one of our many delicious craft cocktails, or choose from our extensive selection of fine whiskeys. While you are here don’t miss our delicious happy hour menu. We have everyone’s favorites, chicken wings, nachos, pretzel sticks, and sliders as well as our signature happy hour selections, lamb lollipops, chorizo fries and others.

Event Catering
Make party planning easy for any special occasion or event
Let us turn your special event into a dream experience. Whether it be a wedding, birthday party, intimate home dinner party, or business lunch. Let our executive chef and his team create a custom menu to meet all your needs. From planning to prep, delivery, and clean up you will be in good hands from start to finish. See why we’re getting rave reviews.
